summary:
A scene from an animated Chinese ink-wash storybook retelling an ancient story. Animated traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (shuimo) on warm aged rice paper: loose expressive black ink brushstrokes, soft grey washes, lots of open space, muted earthy colors. It looks like a hand-painted storybook coming to life, with gentle painterly motion. Characters are stylized painted figures.

detailed_description:

The composition is clean and simple: plain ground, clear calm air, only the characters and objects described. Natural, unhurried, physically plausible motion; everyone stays fully inside the frame in one continuous shot. Animated traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (shuimo) on warm aged rice paper: loose expressive black ink brushstrokes, soft grey washes, lots of open space, muted earthy colors. It looks like a hand-painted storybook coming to life, with gentle painterly motion. Characters are stylized painted figures.
